goal: 按时间先后排列一件事：先找时间词，时间词就是路标

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话
rounds.tip: 先找时间词：at seven → after → on the way → and then

blocks.text: I got up at seven this morning.
After breakfast, I went to school.
On the way, I met an old friend.
We talked for a while and then said goodbye.

distractors.text: I usually go to bed at eleven.

rounds.explain: 按时间排的关键是找「时间词」：at seven → After breakfast → On the way → and then，这四个词本身就是路标。最后那句说晚上十一点睡觉，和早上出门这条时间线对不上。
rounds.example: 信号词：at seven / After… / On the way / and then
rounds.win: 时间词就是段落的路标。

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话
rounds.tip: 先说什么时候出发，再说到哪儿、做了什么

blocks.text: Last summer, my family went to the beach.
We left home early in the morning.
When we arrived, the sun was already high.
We swam and played until the evening.

distractors.text: My father does not like swimming at all.

rounds.explain: 叙事段落的常规写法：先交代时间地点（Last summer），再说出发，再说到达，最后说做了什么。最后那句说爸爸不喜欢游泳，和「我们游泳玩到晚上」直接矛盾，不能放进来。
rounds.example: Last summer → left home → arrived → swam and played
rounds.win: 时间线要顺，前后不能打架。

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话
rounds.tip: 休息 → 开始写 → 写了多久 → 之后做什么

blocks.text: I came home and had a short rest.
It took me about two hours.
After that, I watched TV for a while.

distractors.text: I forgot to bring my book home.

rounds.explain: 短句之间用 Then / After that 串起来，时间线就清楚了。最后那句说「忘带书回家」——如果真忘了，后面根本做不了作业，所以它和整段冲突。
rounds.example: had a rest → Then started → took two hours → After that
rounds.win: 注意句子之间不能互相矛盾。
